title: Show authors by name
description: Lists say 'yours' for your own work but nothing for others: owners are Cognito usernames (google_...). Needs a public profile (display name) per person.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Plan: people pick a unique public handle at first sign-in (Profile + Handle models; Handle id = handle for atomic uniqueness). Lists show 'by @handle'. Change handle in Account settings.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployed (Amplify job 48, commit 48abb3a); prod smoke passed.
